INV_001.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_001.text: Hey. I live next to your farm. I heard about the government's plan to take this land.

INV_002.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_002.text: I was planning to focus on my research and inventions, but if this land is taken, my work here could be affected too.

INV_003.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_003.text: The problem is, research does not make me much money. So I thought maybe we could make a deal.

INV_004.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_004.text: I can build better technological equipment for your farm. Better tools and machines could help you work faster and earn more money.

INV_005.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_005.text: In return, you give me money to support my research. If my equipment improves your farm, you may be able to earn enough to buy the land back sooner.

PLAYER_004.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_004.text: So I help fund your research, and you help me improve the farm.

INV_006.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_006.text: Exactly. We both need money, and we both want to stay here. Working together gives us a better chance.

PLAYER_005.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_005.text: All right. If your inventions can help me save this farm, I am willing to work with you.

INV_007.speaker: Technological Inventor
INV_007.text: Good. I will prepare some upgrades. When you have enough money, come find me and I will show you what I can build.

PLAYER_006.speaker: {player}
PLAYER_006.text: Then I have another way to make this farm stronger. Maybe buying the land back is possible after all.
